narration:3:1660001002:0.text: The wind howls through Cedartown. Snow falls so thickly you can barely see the road ahead...
narration:3:1660001002:0.source_cn: 抵达之日，雪松镇上狂风席卷，暴雪弥漫，几乎让人分辨不出...

say:11:1660001006:1.text: They looked like they'd been through a lot. So I gave them a room and put them to work. Fair trade, I'd say.

say:12:1660001007:1.text: Then they asked if there was anyone around who knew magic. I said, "Well, as a matter of fact... I do know someone. Someone very capable."
